```blade
<div class="max-w-3xl mx-auto py-8">
    <div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
        <h2 class="text-2xl font-bold">Tag List</h2>
        @if (Auth::user()->can('create_tags'))
            <button wire:click="createTag" class="bg-blue-500 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded-md hover:bg-blue-600">
                Create Tag
            </button>
        @endif
    </div>

    <table class="w-full border-collapse">
        <thead>
            <tr class="bg-gray-100">
                <th class="border p-4 text-left">ID</th>
                <th class="border p-4 text-left">Name</th>
                @if (Auth::user()->can('update_tags'))
                    <th class="border p-4 text-center">Edit</th>
                @endif
                @if (Auth::user()->can('delete_tags'))
                    <th class="border p-4 text-center">Delete</th>
                @endif
            </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
            @foreach ($tags as $tag)
                <tr class="bg-white border hover:bg-gray-100">
                    <td class="border p-4">{{ $tag->id }}</td>
                    <td class="border p-4">{{ $tag->name }}</td>
                    @if (Auth::user()->can('update_tags'))
                        <td class="border p-4 text-center">
                            <a href="{{ route('tag.edit', $tag) }}" class="text-blue-500 hover:text-blue-600">Edit</a>
                        </td>
                    @endif
                    @if (Auth::user()->can('delete_tags'))
                        <td class="border p-4 text-center">
                            <form wire:submit.prevent="deleteTag({{ $tag->id }})" method="POST" class="inline-block">
                                @csrf
                                <button type="submit" class="text-red-500 hover:text-red-600">Delete</button>
                            </form>
                        </td>
                    @endif
                </tr>
            @endforeach
        </tbody>
    </table>

    {{ $tags->links() }}
</div>
```
